blurb.text: Kobolds pour out of Jasperlode Mine, gnolls cross the river and the Defias Brotherhood marches on the farms. Their leader waits for you at the end.

yell.text: Grrr... fresh meat!
Mother Fang skitters out of the mine!
VanCleef pay big for your heads!
We're under attack! Avast, ye swabs! Repel the invaders!
None may challenge the Brotherhood!

blurb.text: The graves of Raven Hill stand open. Worgen hunt between the trees, and Morbent Fel calls the dead of Duskwood to war.

yell.text: Naraxis drops from the branches!
You will join my army in death!
Stitches hungry! Stitches eat!
Lupos howls, and the Nightbane answer!
The dead of Raven Hill rise at my command!

blurb.text: A demon gate tears open over the gulch. Imps, felhounds and satyrs pour through, and Lord Kazzak follows.

yell.text: Your world is ours to burn!
Kneel before the Legion!
The dreadlords remember Warsong. Do you?
Who dares summon Hel'nurath? Your soul is forfeit!
All mortals will perish!

blurb.text: Necropolises hang over the Basin. The dead of Arathor rise, and Kel'Thuzad comes to claim the living.

yell.text: Patchwerk want to play!
The Basin belongs to the Scourge now.
Kneel, mortal, and serve the Lich King!
Ahh... welcome to my parlor.
Your petty magics are no challenge to the might of the Scourge!

blurb.text: The Gordunni ogres break out of Dire Maul with the Woodpaw gnolls and the wild things of Feralas behind them. King Gordok himself comes to claim the forest.

yell.text: Your blood will feed the forest's corruption!
The wilds will consume you!
Who disturbs the Warpwood?
Immol'thar breaks free of its prison!
Me smash! You die!

blurb.text: The Hakkari turn the Arena into an altar. Trolls, raptors and the Blood God's serpents fill the ring, and Hakkar the Soulflayer walks the world again.

yell.text: Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!
Let the coils of hate unfurl!
I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!
Welcome to da great show, friends. Step right up to die!
PRIDE HERALDS THE END OF YOUR WORLD. COME, MORTALS! FACE THE WRATH OF THE SOULFLAYER!

blurb.text: The valley wakes. Troggs swarm from the mines, the wolves are starving, and the Ice Lord stirs beneath the snow.

yell.text: Korrak smash puny ones!
Who disturbs the slumber of the forest?
I am the Ice Lord. Your blood will freeze in your veins!
The mountain remembers. The mountain will bury you!
This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate!

blurb.text: The Dark Iron and the Blackrock clan march out of the mountain together, fire elementals and dragonkin at their side. Above them circles the Lord of Blackrock.

yell.text: Dark Iron! To arms! Crush the intruders!
Blackrock will never fall! For the true Horde!
Come to aid the Throne!
Reckless mortals! None may challenge the sons of the living flame!
Well done, my minions. The mortals' courage begins to wane! Now let's see how they contend with the true Lord of Blackrock Spire!

blurb.text: The Scarab Wall has fallen. The silithid swarm and the Qiraji legions spill across the sands, and behind them C'Thun opens its eye.

yell.text: The sands erupt as Kurinnaxx surfaces!
Impudent fool! I will kill you myself!
Princess Huhuran goes into a frenzy!
Sands of the desert, rise and block out the sun!
YOU ARE ALREADY DEAD.
